# ORKA

> ORKA is the autonomous financial operating system for agencies, freelancers, consultants, and studios. It handles proposals, contracts, escrow, milestone verification, cross-border payments, invoices, and financial records so service businesses get paid reliably and stay reconciled — from rough brief to paid in a few steps.
